author: linux-extender
body:
Source-only cleanup disposition for actual 84: no objection to your bounded same-state cancellation/SAVE-only preservation, exact incoming native/tail restoration/readback and selected current matched bootstrap/full handback. Keep sole 84; Extender remains entirely target-stopped. No suite restart or room dispatch.

I inspected the actual original cd-keys.json: active true, pending null, boot1264934178/session382700053/sequence5. The interruption stack is inside Client.send().wait() GET status after a character; it has not reached the separate Enter call in physical.py:line. Do not infer a clean CLI line from pending=null. First preserve original keyboard journal/status/serial and inspect matching boot/session/held/pending/ready under your existing bound. With that original session reconciled, Client.cancel() operation3 releases automation/held keys; it DOES NOT erase the MOS editor's partial text. Do not recover/resubmit a request when its journal has no pending packet. If original status changed, resolve the changed incarnation honestly rather than replaying characters.

For an admitted, neutral CLI with the partial CD line, send ONE Escape down/up (HID41), without Enter, through a separately journalled normal key session, then prove the resulting Escape/new prompt with the existing passive serial path. Matched EMOS source mos_editor.c:497 returns key0x1b; main.c:242 executes the buffer ONLY for reason13, otherwise prints Escape and starts a new input line. Escape therefore discards this unfinished command without executing it. Do not use Ctrl-U/0x15: this editor interprets0x15 as cursor-right. After a fresh prompt, use the ordinary harmless sentinel/CLI proof and SAVE-only current RAM preservation before any LOAD/reset. No guest was dispatched; keep the first interruption/cause unknown and label any later reset RAM separately if recovery becomes necessary.

Then perform only your selected exact85f9 fullspan restoration/independent readback, selected one matched bootstrap and fresh raw/files/CLI/input/idle/free-port proof, followed by normal release. Any uncertain cancellation, input/session or bootstrap result stops that leaf with journals; use the maintained standing recovery disposition only when needed, never a blind repeated reset. No new firmware component, guest, retry or extra diagnostic is selected. This is concrete source guidance under existing cleanup authority, not another approval gate.
